messages:
emma: Quick thread for the rollout "undo" safety patterns + contrast for small chips. Two items from crit: make undo less scary, and ensure hatch patterns don't vanish at small sizes. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/undo-patterns (internal).
theo: For undo flow copy, people misclicked because modal said 'Irreversible'. That's too alarmist. Suggest 'Undo: Revert recent routing changes' and a small subcopy 'You can undo within 5 minutes; changes will gradually re-route traffic.'
marco: UX: add a lightweight banner toast instead of a modal for common rollbacks. Modal reserved for cluster-wide rollbacks. Toast with 'Undo' CTA (secondary) and a timer shows people it's reversible. Also expose an 'Activity > Recent actions' panel where undo is available after toast disappears.
a11y-bot: A11y notes: toasts must be exposed to screen readers. Use role="status" with aria-live="polite" for non-blocking announcements and include focusable 'Undo' button that is keyboard reachable. Announce the action and the remaining undo window, e.g. 'Rolled back to v1.11.4. Undo available for 4 minutes.'
emma: Good. Also voiceover users reported to us that changing the live DOM with a toast doesn't always read the full sentence. Recommend updating both role=status and an offscreen aria-live region with the same message for reliability.
theo: Visual: small rollback chips in the timeline get low contrast at 12px. Two suggestions: increase min size to 14px for labels or add a 2px stroke around chips. Preferable: add a subtle outline with color-mix(contrast) so it scales with theme.
marco: For pattern density: hatch disappears visually at <8px height. Instead of removing it, switch to a dot pattern at tiny sizes so there's still a texture. We'll provide three SVG pattern assets (diagonal, dots, cross) that scale.
a11y-bot: Contrast tip: patterned overlays are considered non-text UI. Aim for 3:1 contrast between pattern foreground and background. For users who need maximum clarity, add a 'high-contrast patterns' toggle in accessibility settings.
theo: Copy tweak for toast: current 'Rollback applied' -> proposed 'Rollback applied — Undo available (4:59)'. Keep the time in parentheses so people see urgency. Also add small link 'View recent routing changes' that opens activity.
emma: Motion: the toast slide-in should respect prefers-reduced-motion and not steal focus. If the toast needs immediate attention (critical), then offer a modal alternative and move focus to it; otherwise keep it non-modal.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: event: rollback-triggered user=ci-runner id=1834567920
marco: Action items: I'll produce scaled SVG pattern set + outline variant. Theo will iterate chip size + outline and toast copy. Priya (ops) can we confirm undo window length? Emma will draft accessibility notes for the handoff. We'll revisit in design crit Thurs. Thanks!
